doc.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Shadow Wilson, Joe Harris and other bebop-era drummers
summary: He and Brown run through Shadow Wilson, Teddy Stewart, Charlie Persip and Joe Harris, saying every drummer then could play.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: What about some other drummers like probably more contemporary of you, maybe Shadow Wilson.
Shadow was dynamite. We were good friends. It was shock man when he got -- what was it a taxi?

I think so, a taxi accident. Shadow could play, man. All them dudes could play, man. Teddy Stewart could play. Who teaches at the school? Charlie Percip. They all could play man. At that time -- every drummer that was on the scene could play.
Did you know Joe Harris from Pittsburgh?
Yeah, sure. Joe, he was a good player, man.
